candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory and shall try their works, and their places shall be without number' — the Elect One enthroned for judgment. Tewahedo Christology reads this verse with Mt 25:31 (Son-of-Man on throne-of-glory) as direct textual genealogy: the Synoptic image of the Son of Man enthroned for judgment is verbally Enochic, with the Tewahedo liturgical reading making this dependency explicit.

candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light, and I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: and I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it' — new-heaven-new-earth theology. Tewahedo eschatology reads this verse as parallel and prior textual basis for Rev 21:1-5, with the Parables providing the verbal pattern (transform-heaven-transform-earth) that the Apocalypse expands.
